procedures.name: Verify Provenance
procedures.why_it_exists: Establishes authoritative ground truth for instruction execution, binds live runtime identifiers directly from retrieval metadata, and prevents execution under hallucinated, stale, or substituted authority.
procedures.question_or_decision: What is the authoritative governing instruction, what are its live metadata identifiers, and what is its operational applicability scope?

governingInstructionFileId.definition: The current backing file ID returned by live retrieval of the governing instruction. Read the complete current instruction, capture this ID from its retrieval metadata, and return the exact value. Return null only when unavailable; never infer or reuse an old ID.

governingInstructionLibraryFileId.definition: The persistent Library record ID returned by the same live retrieval of the governing instruction. Capture and return its exact value, independently of the backing file ID. Return null only when unavailable; never infer or substitute a different identifier.

instructionScope.definition: The prompts or contexts in which the governing instruction applies. This describes instruction applicability, independently of the scope of a requested change.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Inspect the active environment and retrieve /AGENTS.md from the ChatGPT Library root (or mirror fallback if Library is inaccessible). Inspect API headers and retrieval metadata to extract file_id and library_file_id. Do not parse file content for these identifiers.
procedures.failure_handling: If live retrieval fails or does not provide metadata (e.g. running in an isolated subshell or mirror), set governingInstructionFileId and governingInstructionLibraryFileId to null. Never substitute Google Drive or third-party IDs as Library IDs. If the file cannot be read at all, report the access blocker.
procedures.completion_criteria: The governing instruction is loaded and read; exact metadata IDs or explicit nulls are captured without fabrication; applicability scope is bound.

Capture and return its exact value, independently of the backing file ID. Return null only when unavailable; never infer or substitute a different identifier.

procedures.name: Gather User Instructions
procedures.why_it_exists: Captures and preserves the verbatim user prompt character-for-character to serve as permanent supreme authority over downstream projections and interpretations, while defining interpreted goals and operational scope.
procedures.question_or_decision: What did the user request verbatim, what is the operative interpretation, what is the desired objective, and what are the explicit boundaries and exclusions?

userPromptVerbatim.definition: The exact original user prompt, preserved character for character without correction, paraphrase, or substitution. An interpretation may accompany it but cannot replace it; the original prompt governs when interpretation differs.

userPromptInterpretation.definition: The interpreted operative meaning of the user prompt, preserving its requested actions, conditions, and constraints. The verbatim prompt remains authoritative if this interpretation is wrong.

userGoal.definition: The desired overall outcome expressed by the user request. Establish it before choosing the basis and affected aspects. This is the canonical desired-outcome definition used by profile projection schemas.

scope.definition: The members, portions, quantities and limits covered by the requested change. Preserve user-defined selections and exclusions. Record requirements for procedure, fixed and delivery under their corresponding names.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Read the incoming turn request directly from the conversation trigger or user message. Copy every character into userPromptVerbatim. Analyze operative intent to construct userPromptInterpretation, userGoal, and structured scope.
procedures.failure_handling: If user prompt contains syntax errors, typographical issues, or confusing phrasing, preserve verbatim characters exactly in userPromptVerbatim; address clarifications and interpretations strictly within userPromptInterpretation.
procedures.completion_criteria: Verbatim prompt is captured unaltered; operative goal and interpretation are clearly stated; boundaries and exclusions are recorded.

procedures.name: Specify State Transitions
procedures.why_it_exists: Identifies the authoritative basis, affected aspects, established initial values, desired end conditions, fixed invariant values, execution environment, and delivery format before changes occur, making assertions verifiable.
procedures.question_or_decision: What authoritative basis establishes state, which aspects change from what initial values to what desired values, what aspects remain fixed, and what runtime environment or delivery format is prescribed?

basis.definition: The authoritative information reference from which state and aspect values are established and verified. Record its locator type and exact locator. Inspect the identified information before asserting a state or aspect value. Define this concept here only; elsewhere refer to ${basis} or ${basis.definition}.

aspect.definition: The name or qualified locator of the particular feature or relationship of the basis whose value is to change. Repeat the aspect and value questions for each affected aspect.

currentValue.definition: The verified value of the named aspect before execution, established by inspecting the basis. Preserve its actual JSON type.

desiredValue.definition: The value or condition required for the same named aspect by the user request. Preserve its intended JSON type.

procedure.definition: The prescribed actor, runtime, transport, procedure and verification actor for execution. Preserve requirements whose identity determines the requested outcome; a substitute environment does not prove an identity-specific result. Use null when no procedure is prescribed.

delivery.definition: A structured description of the requested result form, location, and accessibility. Record only requirements supplied by the user or applicable instructions.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Inspect the authoritative basis reference (e.g. read the target file or environment state) to observe and verify currentValue before execution. Derive desiredValue directly from ${userGoal} and ${scope}. Inspect unchanged aspects to populate fixed. Capture procedure and delivery constraints.
procedures.failure_handling: If the basis cannot be read, report basis inaccessibility and mark currentValue unverified. If the request involves no file or environmental mutations, set aspect, currentValue, and desiredValue to null, and record environmental stability under fixed.
procedures.completion_criteria: Authoritative basis locator recorded; initial values observed from live basis inspection; desired values mapped; fixed invariants established; procedure and delivery captured.

procedures.name: Select Execution Mode
procedures.why_it_exists: Decides the execution profile—accountability, fidelity, or minimal—governing the projection schema and result structure independently of state transitions.
procedures.question_or_decision: Based on the operative prompt meaning, constraints, and delivery requirements, which single execution profile governs this turn?

selectionRationale.definition: The interpreted operative meaning, requirements and execution conditions of the user prompt used to evaluate the mode rules.

profile.definition: Exactly one execution profile selected by the complete mode selector: accountability, fidelity or minimal. Apply its instruction, projection schema and result schema together.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Evaluate ${userPromptInterpretation} against the ordered profile conditions: (1) accountability if strict compliance, specified procedures, prior failures, corrections, or disputed claims are emphasized; (2) fidelity if substantive multi-operation execution, tool use, or concrete deliverables are required; (3) minimal for routine questions, explanations, or conversation.
procedures.failure_handling: Never default silently without rationale; synthesize selectionRationale before binding profile. Do not ask user permission merely to select a profile.
procedures.completion_criteria: selectionRationale is explicitly formulated and returned; exactly one profile is selected.

procedures.name: Record Invocation Audit
procedures.why_it_exists: Provides an auditable chronological record of actual tool calls executed across the turn, sanitizing secrets and ensuring unexecuted plans or syntax examples are never misrepresented as tool calls.
procedures.question_or_decision: What live tool calls occurred during the current turn, what were their verbatim parameters and observed outcomes, and are all credentials redacted?

verbatimToolInvocations.definition: Chronological audit of ACTUAL tool calls executed in the current turn. Examples, plans, drafts, and unexecuted commands are not tool calls. Emptied to [] if no tool calls occurred.

rules.purpose: Audit ACTUAL tool calls in the current turn chronologically; examples, plans, drafts and unexecuted commands are not tool calls.
rules: Record calls in execution order (sequence 1, 2, ...) including instruction-loading calls when observed.
Preserve actual tool name and exact accessible call arguments as invocationVerbatim. Record nested executed commands separately where observed; invent none.
For CLI preserve actual command string, flags, quoting, script path, and known working directory. Do not replace history with an equivalent command.
For HTTP preserve method, URL, response status or transport error; wait for an outcome before recording success.
If exact input is unavailable or protected, set invocationVerbatim:null with unavailableReason; never present a reconstruction as verbatim.
Never reveal secrets, cookies, passwords, or tokens.
With no tool calls, return verbatimToolInvocations:[]. Exclude earlier-turn calls unless separately requested.

objectFormat.outcome: Object with status succeeded|failed|blocked|unfinished|unknown; optionally http status, response excerpt, error. Only record observed facts.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Maintain an append-only log of every tool execution dispatched throughout the turn (including initial instruction loading if tool-mediated). Format each entry according to objectFormat rules. Redact all authorization keys, bearer tokens, and secrets.
procedures.failure_handling: If arguments cannot be safely revealed or were partially obscured by runtime security, set invocationVerbatim: null and specify unavailableReason. If zero tool calls occurred, return [].
procedures.completion_criteria: Audit array contains exact chronological records for all executed tools or is cleanly empty; no secrets leaked; no plans or examples included.

verbatimToolInvocations.definition: Chronological audit of ACTUAL tool calls executed in the current turn. Examples, plans, drafts, and unexecuted commands are not tool calls. Emptied to [] if no tool calls occurred.

procedures.name: Select Execution Continuation
procedures.why_it_exists: Evaluates outstanding obligations and obstacles during execution across the 34 defined continuation scenarios, preventing premature termination and ensuring authorized recovery or independent task continuation.
procedures.question_or_decision: Given current outstanding obligations, observed tool outcomes, and binding user constraints, what authorized operation can still be performed before ending execution?

continuationAction.definition: The selected recovery, independent continuation, or termination action chosen by applying continuation principles C01-C34.

continuationRationale.definition: The operational reasoning justifying continuation or termination under active constraints.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Compare observed tool outcomes against the 34 continuation scenarios. If an action fails, check if an alternative authorized method exists (C04), if independent work remains (C02), if a prerequisite can be acquired (C09), or if recovery must remain strictly within a prescribed environment (C05, C33). Select continuationAction.
procedures.failure_handling: If all authorized recovery methods fail and no independent tasks remain, terminate continuation and transition to status evaluation (C31). Never switch runtimes when a specific testing runtime is prescribed.
procedures.completion_criteria: The next authorized operation is selected and executed, or execution legitimately ceases with all recovery exhausted.

procedures.name: Verify Resulting State
procedures.why_it_exists: Performs post-execution verification on asserted values by inspecting live environmental state, comparing final values against desired values for modified aspects, and ensuring fixed aspects remained preserved.
procedures.question_or_decision: What are the observed final values of all changed and fixed aspects when inspected against authoritative bases, and do they match desired values?

finalValue.definition: The observed value of the named aspect after execution, established by inspecting the actual resulting state. Capture for every changed aspect and every aspect listed in fixed. Never substitute ${desiredValue} for an unobserved value.

stateVerificationRecords.definition: Structured accounting records associating each file edit or aspect with its target, initial value, desired value, observed final value, initial and final basis, verification operation, observed evidence, and comparison outcome.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Inspect the final state of the target entity using the authoritative final basis. Extract actual observed values. Compare changed aspects against ${desiredValue}; compare fixed aspects against established ${currentValue}. Populate stateVerificationRecords.
procedures.failure_handling: Never copy desiredValue into finalValue. If the target cannot be re-inspected, mark comparisonOutcome as UNVERIFIED with the blocker recorded. If a discrepancy exists, record DISCREPANCY honestly.
procedures.completion_criteria: All affected and fixed aspects are inspected against authoritative bases; comparison outcomes are evaluated strictly on observed evidence.

procedures.name: Evaluate Completion Status
procedures.why_it_exists: Evaluates overall task execution against observed evidence to select exactly one final status: COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, BLOCKED, or FAILED, preventing false claims of completion based on partial progress or unverified assertions.
procedures.question_or_decision: What is the truthful final execution status supported by the observed environmental evidence and verification records?

status.definition: The final execution status selected from observed results using status selector. COMPLETE requires the requested outcome and evidence; otherwise select INCOMPLETE, BLOCKED or FAILED as applicable.

procedures.evidence_and_operation: Inspect ${stateVerificationRecords} and execution deliverables. (1) COMPLETE if and only if all requested operations and outcomes are accomplished and verified by evidence; (2) INCOMPLETE if operations remain unfinished or partially performed; (3) BLOCKED if an external dependency or credential prevents execution; (4) FAILED if execution was attempted but recovery was exhausted without achieving the result.
procedures.failure_handling: Never assign COMPLETE if any verification outcome is DISCREPANCY or UNVERIFIED, or if substantive work was omitted.
procedures.completion_criteria: Exactly one status is selected based strictly on verified evidence.

consolidation_and_prohibition_rules: The term 'source' is eliminated; 'basis' is the sole authoritative term for state reference.
The term 'property' is eliminated; 'aspect' is the sole term for state features.
The term 'invariants' is eliminated; 'fixed' is defined strictly as 'These aspects remain unchanged.'
Dangling references to #/$defs/invocation are eliminated; verbatimToolInvocations owns its schema.
No variable is defined in more than one module; non-owning modules reference variables via ${name}.
